verdict.rationale: Replit documents a visual design space where you can "explore and tweak designs visually, and then apply them directly to your app," and says you can iterate on layouts and components. That points toward direct visual editing, but nothing confirms you can select a specific element or edit its text, style, or layout without prompting Agent. The template flow (selecting a frame) still routes the build through Agent. Missing for 10: explicit element selection, direct inline text/style/layout editing controls, confirmation that edits skip an Agent prompt, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can select an element and edit its text, style, or layout directly without a prompt round-trip

citations.quote: Introducing a new space that allows you to explore and tweak designs visually, and then apply them directly to your app.
Iterate on layouts, components, and experiences.
